name: Slum
desc: A childhood under a tin roof, with violence and scarcity as the daily background noise.

name: Rural Village
desc: Fields, farming seasons, and a childhood of waiting for parents away in the cities.

name: Small Town
desc: In a town where everyone knows you, everyone knows your report card too.

name: Urban Middle Class
desc: The standard script: school-district apartments and after-school tutoring.

name: Wealthy Family
desc: Born with a silver spoon in your mouth—and the family's expectations right beside it.

name: Scholarly Family
desc: More bookshelves than toys; philosophy at the dinner table.

name: Single-Parent Family
desc: One person carrying love enough for two; the cracks hide in the silence.

name: Street Orphan
desc: A beginning with no surname; the first thing the world teaches you is hunger.

name: War Zone
desc: The white noise of childhood is distant shelling—your HPA axis was rewired before you learned to walk.

name: Opera / Showbiz Family
desc: Voice training at three, on stage at five; beauty is the family motto.

name: Military Family
desc: Blankets folded into perfect blocks, tears swallowed back down.

name: Remote Mountains
desc: Two hours of mountain roads to school—but the starry sky is free.

name: Cult Family
desc: You were born in a temple compound, not a hospital; your lullabies were prayers, and the "people outside" were lost sheep awaiting salvation. Your amygdala learned fear before you learned to speak.
